pages.text: Returns the ISO 8601 week of the year (1 to 53).

Week 1 contains the first Thursday of the year. So days around New Year can belong to week 52 or 53 of the old year or week 1 of the new one. Without $(1)time$() the current time is used. It uses the time zone of the server.

There is no function for the year a week belongs to. On 1 January 2027, WEEK gives 53, the last week of 2026, but YEAR gives 2027. So if WEEK is 52 or 53 in January, the week belongs to the year before; if it is 1 in December, to the year after.
$(li)$(1)time$() TIME: the time (optional, default now)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the week, 1 to 53
